facts.fact: Judicalex, the operator of the Conakry commercial court's digitisation platform, says digitisation projects for the RCCM and other requests are in development for the coming months.
Judicalex says it has digitised the hearing roll, now online, and all decisions of the Conakry commercial court since its creation, including judgments and orders.

systems.owner: Judicalex (company, partner of Tribunal de commerce de Conakry)
